claim.doc: Take the task. Held as a lease, it lasts while the claimer's socket is open.

edit.doc: Rewrite the task's description or acceptance criteria.

set_status.doc: Move the task to public.status (todo, doing, review, blocked...).

comment.doc: Add a comment or a finding.

depend.doc: This task is blocked by public.target, a task key.

merge.doc: Fold this duplicate into public.into; its key becomes task:<public.into>.

notes.claim/claim: Someone else took the task first: pick another.
notes.release/claim: Releasing now would drop the claim someone else just made.
notes.claim/close: The task is done; there is nothing to take.
notes.claim/merge: The task was folded into another; the claim follows it there.
notes.edit/edit: Two rewrites of one description: merge locally.
notes.set_status/set_status: Two agents disagree about where the task stands.
notes.close/claim: Someone just started on it: ask before closing.
notes.close/edit: The criteria changed since you checked them.
notes.close/depend: A new blocker arrived since you checked.
notes.merge/claim: Someone is working on this duplicate: ask before folding it away.
notes.comment/*: Comments never conflict; they land in sequence order.
